expected_heading: Preview: Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information
section: Preview: Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information
paraphrase: The version of the sensitive-permissions policy taking effect on 27 January 2027: the location button becomes the recommended minimum scope for precise location, and apps targeting Android 17 or later may request READ_CONTACTS only where the Contact Picker is not enough, with a Play Console declaration.
quote: Apps that still request the READ_CONTACTS permission must submit a Play Console declaration to demonstrate access needs for Contacts and why Contact Picker would not suffice.
